string.text: Invalid API URL or unsupported protocol; V3 requires /api/v3/tts/unidirectional and Agent Plan requires /api/v3/plan/tts/unidirectional (HTTP, not SSE/WS).

For GPT-SoVITS (manual API), for example http://127.0.0.1:9880/tts. AF-GPTSOVITS manages the installed service automatically.
AF-GPTSOVITS reads the module VoicePacks directory. Manual API may use an explicit manifest. Assign voices in the encyclopedia before chatting; Custom voices are not random defaults.
Enable speech and select AF-GPTSOVITS or manual API first. The managed service must be ready; real battles disable local synthesis.

Changes voice only, not text language or persona
Default voices match gender. Custom voices require manual selection and never enter random pools. You can select before your first conversation; saved with this campaign.
Battle rewards have been handled. Enter GCCZ to continue, or leave.
Choose local GPT-SoVITS or Volcengine TTS API. Custom is reserved and outputs text only. Switching preserves credentials; local failures never fall back to paid cloud speech.
Five male and five female default voices. Custom voices are manual-only and can be assigned in the encyclopedia before any conversation.
Audition tone: 0 Calm / 1 Happy / 2 Angry / 3 Sad
Audition only. Dialogue tone comes from this turn’s postprocess mood; missing or late results use Calm, not tags in the main reply.
Supports existing V1, V3 HTTP unidirectional and Agent Plan gateways. See official documentation below. SSE/WS is not implemented.
V1 uses the legacy token; V3 uses the speech-service API key. Agent Plan requires its dedicated key. Switching does not erase credentials.
AnimusForge Speech TTS Local deployment / API
Custom provider is reserved; no request is sent. Custom local voices can already be assigned manually in the encyclopedia.
Save the TTS settings before testing.
Voice category must match the declared gender or be custom.
Voice tones must be valid neutral, happy, angry or sad reference entries (at most four).
Voice migration must point directly to an existing voice and must not replace an existing ID.
Tone reference provenance does not match the original recording.
Tone recording or its matching transcript is invalid.
Tone recordings must stay inside the voice pack.

Master switch. Local/cloud speech forces main-response SSE without changing your streaming preference. The accepted complete reply is read in sentences with matching text. Only enabled local GPT-SoVITS receives dedicated tone metadata; cloud/custom/off do not request it. Disabling speech restores text-only output.

Starts the compatible L package only when local speech is enabled. A custom API address or explicit voice manifest remains manual. Without an installed package, the existing manual connection remains available. Disable this option to manage the service yourself.
Check installed L/U packages, preferring a verified L. Retries preparation when AF-GPTSOVITS is enabled. With speech off, checks metadata without loading models.
The local voice runtime is preparing or unavailable. This reply remains text-only; check the local runtime status.
AF-GPTSOVITS detects compatible L/U packages in the mod folder (L first). Manual API uses your running local service. Switching preserves all settings; failures remain text-only.
